posts.text: Column: About 8 in 10 Republican registered voters approve of President Trump, but 40 percent “strongly approve,” down from 48 percent who said this one week before the election, according to a new poll.

posts.name: The Washington Post
posts.text: All the pomp and spectacle of a summit that drew thousands of delegates from four continents, among them President Trump, could not distract from what was unmistakable: This was Chinese leader Xi Jinping’s moment.
posts.text_ko: 트럼프 대통령을 포함해 4개 대륙에서 수천 명의 대표단이 모인 정상회담의 모든 화려함과 광경은 틀림없는 사실을 방해할 수 없었습니다. 바로 이것이 중국 지도자 시진핑의 순간이었습니다.
